title: job.completed (v1)
description: Terminal success of an attempt. Published by the worker host (or optimizer/report/market-data for their kinds) **after** the engine process exited and the attempt's folder is uploaded to MinIO, and before the dispatch is acked. Routing key `job.<kind>.<jobId>.status.v1`, AMQP type `events.v1.JobCompleted`, persistent, with confirms. Carries a MinIO reference to the full result JSON, never the payload (ADR 0005: the futures result was 3.69 MB and publishing it inline cost +12% engine time). Consumed by job-orchestrator (-> completed), optimizer (child results), results (finalise), gateway SSE.

result.description: Main output. backtest/live: `lean-results/<jobId>/<attempt>/<algorithmId>.json`, the result JSON exactly as the engine wrote it (`BaseResultsHandler.SaveResults`, camelCase, deserializes to `BacktestResult`/`LiveResult`). report: `lean-reports/<jobId>/<attempt>/report.html`. optimization: `lean-results/<jobId>/<attempt>/optimization-result.json` (`OptimizationResult`). marketdata: `lean-results/<jobId>/<attempt>/task-summary.json`.

artifacts.description: Every other uploaded file of the attempt (`-log.txt`, `-order-events.json`, `-summary.json`, object-store files, `report.pdf`, ...).

statistics.description: Optional copy of the final `Statistics` (28 entries, about 2 KB) so job-orchestrator and the optimizer can show/fold headline numbers without downloading `result`. `result` stays authoritative.

algorithmId.description: Engine `AlgorithmId` (`BacktestId`/`DeployId`), the prefix of the result file names.

exitCode.description: Informational. Python jobs currently abort with -6 after a successful run (ADR 0005 finding 5).
